card.name: Words just before a comma and credential
card.fires_on: The last word of a name or product title right before a comma, as in "Jr", "Shah", or "Sodium Chloride Injection" followed by ", USP" or ", MD". The pole responds on the word before the comma, or on the comma itself after a surname.

modes.description: A person's surname or suffix like Jr or Shah is followed by a comma and MD or PhD.

card.writes: It promotes commas and other punctuation, so it predicts a comma coming next.
card.plain: It fires on the end of a name or title where a comma and a credential or label such as MD or USP comes next.
